shortDescription: Manage SNAT translations on a BIG-IP

options.name: address
options.description: Specifies the IP address of the SNAT translation. When C(state) is C(present), C(enabled), or C(disabled), this parameter is required. This parameter cannot be updated after it is set.

options.name: arp
options.description: If C(true), specifies the NAT sends ARP requests.

options.name: connection_limit
options.description: Specifies a limit on the number of connections a translation address must reach before it no longer initiates a connection. The default value of C(0) indicates the setting is disabled. The accepted value range is C(0 - 65535).

options.name: description
options.description: Description of snat-translation. C(none or '') sets a default description of null.

options.name: ip_idle_timeout
options.description: Specifies the amount of time connections to an IP address initiated using a SNAT address are allowed to remain idle before being automatically disconnected. C(indefinite) prevents the connection from timing out. The accepted value range is C(0 - 4294967295) seconds. Specifying C(indefinite) sets it to the maximum value.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on. Required with state C(absent) when a partition other than Common is used.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: The SNAT translation state. If C(absent), deletes the SNAT translation if it exists. C(present) creates the SNAT translation and enables it. If C(enabled), enables the SNAT translation if it exists. If C(disabled), creates the SNAT translation if needed, and sets the state to C(disabled).

options.name: tcp_idle_timeout
options.description: Specifies the amount of time that TCP connections initiated using a SNAT address are allowed to remain idle before being automatically disconnected. C(indefinite) prevents the connection from timing out. The accepted value range is C(0 - 4294967295) seconds. Specifying C(indefinite) sets it to the maximum value.

options.name: traffic_group
options.description: The traffic group for the snat-translation address. When creating a new address, if this value is not specified, the default is C(/Common/traffic-group-1).

options.name: udp_idle_timeout
options.description: Specifies the amount of time UDP connections initiated using a SNAT address are allowed to remain idle before being automatically disconnected. C(indefinite) prevents the connection from timing out. The accepted value range is C(0 - 4294967295) seconds. Specifying C(indefinite) sets it to the maximum value.
